add.description: Add the property with this value, as Sass source, to calls of the owner that do not pass it

exactOwner.description: Match only the owner's exact name. By default, any member whose name ends with the owner matches

owner.description: Theming function this parameter belongs to

ownerType.description: Apply the property change only where the owner is called as a function or included as a mixin

parameterIndex.description: The property's 1-based index in the owner's parameters. It only detects calls that pass the property by position: add leaves them alone, and remove reports them for manual review

replaceWith.description: Replace original selector/property with new one

type.description: The type of the change: variable, function, mixin

changes.description: An array of changes to theme function properties
